signal_text: A Gumroad help center article (dated February 21, 2022) stated that the most common items sold on Gumroad are e-books, films, music, software, and tutorials, and that memberships and one-time purchase products (both digital and physical) are also available.
subject_exact: Gumroad most commonly sold product types (e-books, films, music, software, tutorials) as stated by platform
extraction_notes: Source dated February 2022. 'Most common' is the platform's claim, not independently verified. Films, music, tutorials do not map to schema product_type enum. Source is creatorpedia FAQ page.
